observations.meaning: All six oracle questions were answered correctly from the uploaded 3-page PDF, including a paraphrase probe, a near-miss numeric pair (17 vs 71, no contamination) and an unanswerable probe (clean refusal). Three tool calls were recorded in the thread, matching the three UI badges 'đã đọc tài liệu nguồn'. R4 quoted the page-3 sentence verbatim and additionally stated the exception does not waive the ORBIT-294 >= 17 condition, which is consistent with the fixture.
limits: Citation ACCURACY: R4 located the quote on the correct page (3) and quoted it verbatim, but no clickable citation object was opened in the UI, so page/chunk locator correctness for the structured cite{anchor,label} is only partially verified.

Tool NAMES were not readable: REA retained the shape (name:string, summary:string, ok:boolean) but the values were not surfaced in accessibility text. Therefore read_source vs explain_deeper cannot be attributed.
n=1 per question. Post-hoc rephrasing was not repeated, so this is pilot evidence.
The 3 tool calls correlate 1:1 with the 3 questions that produced a UI badge, but correlation is not proof that each badge equals a distinct tool invocation.
Retrieval mechanism (dense/sparse/hybrid), embeddings, chunker, reranker remain UNKNOWN. Grounding does not identify the retriever.
One 401 burst followed by /auth/refresh shows silent token refresh; this is a client behaviour observation, not an AI capability.
